title: MatMix Solo #44 (새 재질 솔로 · 도자기 분채 · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 blue-black · 메이크업 와인 레드립 극한 · 배경 호텔 로비 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, top bun jet-black hair — full body glazed famille-rose porcelain fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid glazed porcelain curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted porcelain sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING glossy white glaze painted with pink peonies, golden birds and green leaves across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID gold-lined borders and ruby-pink enamel dots running between the sections, with fine gold inlay lines tracing every joint between the sections, high-gloss glazed, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: turned in profile, back arched, looking over her shoulder, one hand on her hip — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same porcelain, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same porcelain with a high polish.
Jewelry: a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT porcelain — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: thick saturated near-black burgundy lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, deep plum-brown smoky eyes, dramatic lashes.

Background: a bright luxury hotel lobby with a polished pale marble floor, a standard-height entrance door, a curved staircase and a long reception counter, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
